text:
Contact Us Wednesday, 9 January 2019 You are here: Home 2019 January “Options Monster” Says AAPL Calls Is Best Play Now – source – CNBC (01/09/2019) “Options Monster” Says AAPL Calls Is Best Play Now – source – CNBC (01/09/2019) Posted on by wsw staff |
Another afternoon on CNBC means another day for someone to say buy AAPL – and not just buy the stock, but gamble with options calls. AAPL remains one of the worst performing stocks in the market lagging the indices even on this bounce, but the CNBC viewers want AAPL buy recos and so CNBC delivers.
